tags.title: Dead!
tags.lyrics-eng:
[ar: My Chemical Romance]
[ti: Dead!]
[al: The Black Parade]
[id: wl_iaunwwqu]

[00:13.00]Verse 1
[00:14.44]And if your heart stops beating
[00:16.84]I'll be here wondering
[00:18.67]Did you get what you deserve?
[00:22.24]The ending of your life
[00:24.02]And if you get to Heaven
[00:26.27]I'll be here waiting babe
[00:28.22]Did you get what you deserve?
[00:32.00]The end, and if your life won't wait,
[00:35.22]Then your heart can't take this
[00:37.60]Chorus
[00:38.38]Have you heard the news that you're dead?
[00:43.06]No one ever had much nice to say
[00:45.40]I think they never liked you anyway
[00:47.48]Oh take me from the hospital bed
[00:52.66]Wouldn't it be grand
[00:53.68]It ain't exactly what you planned
[00:55.00]And wouldn't it be great if
[00:56.74]We were dead
[00:59.30]Oh Dead
[01:01.80]Verse2
[01:02.37]Tongue-tied and oh so squeamish
[01:04.92]You never fell in love
[01:06.71]Did you get what you deserve?
[01:10.30]The ending of your life
[01:12.14]And if you get to Heaven
[01:14.60]I'll be here waiting babe
[01:16.35]Did you get what you deserve?
[01:19.99]The end, and if your life won't wait,
[01:23.20]Then your heart can't take this

[01:25.80]Chorus
[01:26.26]Have you heard the news that you're dead?
[01:30.95]No one ever had much nice to say
[01:33.34]I think they never liked you anyway
[01:35.60]Oh take me from the hospital bed
[01:40.66]Wouldn't it be grand
[01:41.62]To take a pistol by the hand
[01:42.96]And wouldn't it be great if
[01:44.28]We were dead




[01:45.30]Bridge
[01:45.35]And in my honest observation
[01:48.68]During this operation
[01:50.89]Found a complication
[01:52.52]In your heart, so long
[01:56.13]'Cause now you've got
[01:58.85]Maybe just two weeks to live
[02:01.81]is that the most the both of you can give?!

[02:04.72](band instrumental)

[02:26.22]1,2
[02:27.45]1,2,3,4!
[02:28.72]La la la la la
[02:30.93]La la la la la la
[02:33.42]La la la la la la la
[02:37.55]Well c'mon
[02:38.53]La la la la la
[02:40.73]La la la la la la
[02:43.33]La la la la la la la

[02:47.87]Oh, motherfucker
[02:48.44]If life ain't just a joke
[02:51.41]Then why are we laughing?
[02:53.24]If life ain't just a joke
[02:56.46]Then why are we laughing?
[02:58.20]If life ain't just a joke
[03:01.36]Then why are we laughing?
[03:02.94]If life ain't just a joke
[03:06.31]Then why am I dead?

[03:11.51]Dead!
